title: Big Buck Bunny — Blender Open Movie
description: The classic Blender Foundation short film, served straight from the C++ backend with HTTP byte-range streaming. A gentle giant bunny takes revenge on three bullying rodents.

comments.author: Aarav
comments.text: Still holds up in 2026. The rendering is gorgeous.

comments.author: Priya
comments.text: Can't believe the backend serving this is a single C++ file. Respect.

comments.author: DevOpsDave
comments.text: Range requests work perfectly, seeked all over the timeline with zero buffering.

title: Echo — Here We Are (360p demo)
description: Demo clip used to test streaming playback. Uploaded to CppTube to show the watch page: view counter, likes, comments and recommendations all wired to the C++ API.

comments.author: Meera
comments.text: The dark theme is spot on.

comments.author: Rohan
comments.text: Tried uploading my own video — took seconds. Nice work!
